title: fix(types,changesets): quote only the calendar refusal screen's surviving clause (objectui#10030)
body:
Fixes #10030

Clause-②: no — the edit changes quoted example prose in three pending changesets and one author-facing diagnostic string; it widens no accepted shape and adds no exported surface.

## What changed

objectui#8170 (PR objectui#10029) rewrote the second sentence of the calendar refusal screen. That sentence named `titleField` as required, and `titleField` is optional. Four places still quoted the old sentence in full. This PR clips each of those quotes to the screen's first clause, "Calendar configuration required", which the rewrite kept. That is the same clip objectui#10029 made to its own quotes. The conclusion around every quote is unchanged.

| File | Kind | Change |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `.changeset/7029-no-invented-calendar-fields.md` | pending changeset | quote clipped (one line) |
| `.changeset/7711-calendar-filter-is-not-a-config-slot.md` | pending changeset | quote clipped. See "Beyond the claimed file surface" |
| `.changeset/8355-retire-calendar-date-aliases.md` | pending changeset | quote clipped, so the quoted refusal message still matches the message word for word |
| `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` | `CALENDAR_DATE_ALIAS_CONSEQUENCE.dateField.binding`, the message authors see | quote clipped, plus a three-line comment on why only the first clause is quoted |
| `.changeset/10030-calendar-alias-refusal-quotes-surviving-clause.md` | new changeset | `@object-ui/types: patch`. Its body does not quote the false sentence |

Why now: at the next release, a pending changeset is copied word for word into the CHANGELOG. After that, commandment 11 in AGENTS.md forbids editing the paragraph. The release PR objectui#5400 is open and regenerates from `main`, so this change has to land before that PR merges.

## Premises checked on `origin/main` `a78cd37`

- The census ignored line wraps and TS string joins. Over 8246 readable tracked files, the false clause appears in 7. Control in the same pass: the Gantt three-key refusal sentence appears in 4 files. This PR clips the four carriers: the three pending changesets and `objectql.zod.ts`. The other three files quote the old sentence on purpose or lie outside this PR's file surface. See Acceptance notes.
- ⚠️ The dispatch reading said `.changeset/7711-…` no longer carried the sentence. That reading was wrong. In 7711 the sentence wraps across two lines ("…required. Please" / "specify startDateField and titleField."), so a line-based `git grep` for the whole phrase misses it. The reading's control was `Calendar configuration required`, which sits on a single line, so it could not catch a wrapped match. The card's original count of three changesets was right.
- The refusal screen today (`ObjectCalendar.tsx`, `calendar.configRequired`) reads: "Calendar configuration required. Please specify startDateField, the calendar's one required key; the event title resolves without titleField." Every locale still names `startDateField` and `titleField`. So the message's claim that the screen "names the canonical keys and never the key you wrote" is still true, and it stays.
- None of the three changesets has been published. `objectui#7029`, `objectui#7711` and `objectui#8355` each appear in 0 of the 42 tracked `CHANGELOG.md` files. Control: a phrase from the published 17.6.0 entry appears in 3 of them.
- No test pins the false half of the message. The only pin is in `calendar-date-alias-refusal-8355.test.ts`. It asserts `toContain('Calendar configuration required')` on the binding surface and asserts the phrase is absent on the container surface. Both assertions still hold, so no test file changes.

## Beyond the claimed file surface: `.changeset/7711-…`

The claim listed two changesets because it relied on the reading above. 7711 carries the same sentence, and it meets all four conditions for fixing it in place:
- the defect class is the same as this card's;
- the fix is the same mechanical clip;
- no open PR touches the file except the generated release PR objectui#5400 (all 12 open PR file lists read today);
- the gate family is the same.

The card names 7711, and 7711 has the same one-way-door deadline. Leaving it out would break the deadline in the ruling. The seat still needs to add this file to the claim's file surface.

## Verification (head `a6345d9`)

- **One-off probe** (tsx, nothing committed) of the composed refusal message, through `ObjectCalendarSchema` with a flat `dateField` and `ListViewSchema` with `calendar.dateField`.
  - At head: the surviving clause is present and the false clause is absent, on both surfaces.
  - Control leg, with `objectql.zod.ts` checked out from `a78cd37`: the false clause is present on both surfaces.
  - Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`. The blob hash equals the HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Tests:** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/` reports `Test Files 213 passed (213)` and `Tests 4919 passed (4919)`. The pinning file run with the verbose reporter: 23 passed.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` exits 0. Both runs went through the shared verify lock.
- **eslint**, narrowed to the one touched TS file:
  - The population comes from the repo's flat config: `**/*.{ts,tsx}`, and the file is not ignored.
  - `--format json` returns 1 file with 0 errors and 1 warning (`no-explicit-any`). The base file has the same 0 errors and 1 warning; the new comment moves it down 2 lines.
  - Type-aware linting is not configured (`--print-config` shows no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`), so this diff cannot change the verdict for any untouched file.
  - The `.md` changesets are not in any eslint `files` glob.
- **Gates that exit 0:**
  - `check-changeset-presence`: 1 source file of 1 released package changed, 1 changeset added.
  - `check-changeset-no-major`.
  - `check-changeset-overwrite`, report-only: 3 changesets modified. Each one's declared packages and bump levels are identical at base and now.
  - `check-changeset-claims`, report-only: 19 pending changesets name `objectql.zod.ts`. The one that quotes this message, 8355, is updated here. The other 18 describe other members of the file.
  - `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-installed-spec-pin-claims`, `check-handler-key-read-sites` and `check-spec-symbol-derivation`.
- **NOT MEASURED:** `check-readme-exports`. It needs built packages; 36 are unbuilt here, so it refused with a collapsed population and measured nothing. CI builds first.
- **Governed surface:** `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 5 paths returns NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.calendarBinding-7029.test.tsx` has a docblock that quotes the old full sentence. It is outside this PR's file surface, so it is not edited. It reads as history: it is written in the past tense ("This face used to emit…", "it is what made … unreachable from this route") and describes the screen as it was when objectui#7029 landed. It is a test file and is never published.
- `.changeset/8170-calendar-refusal-names-an-actionable-remedy.md` and the refusal-screen docblock in `ObjectCalendar.tsx` quote the old sentence on purpose, as "It used to read …". Both are correct history and are left as they are.
